name: com.cupkekgames.keyvaluedatabases.newtonsoft
description: Newtonsoft <-> KeyValueDatabase bridge: a JsonConverter (registered via a SerializationTypeProviderSO) that (de)serializes KeyValueDatabase<TKey,TValue> through its Pairs list, so the core com.cupkekgames.keyvaluedatabases package stays serializer-agnostic. Pulls in Newtonsoft via com.cupkekgames.newtonsoft.
